in_hebrew.name: Hammerskjold

in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hammerskjold הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old Norse hammr ('stone') and skjoldr ('shield'), Hammerskjold is a name of great historical significance. In Norse mythology, Hammer was the name of the god of thunder, and Skjoldr referred to a legendary hero and king who protected his people from harm.
